checked_claims.note: Clause (4) is not well-posed under the theorem's own hypotheses, and its proof uses a structure that the stated data does not carry. (i) The theorem fixes B as a reduced locally Noetherian k-SCHEME. Then I=Hilb⁶(C/B)×_{Pic⁶(C/B)}B and its open I^{dist} are schemes (algebraic spaces), so for a geometric point x the group Aut(x) is trivial and the whole clause degenerates to 1→1→1→S_6 with Aut(x_tilde)=1 automatic: true but empty. The artifact does not intend that reading — theorem_scope states 'the finite étale torsor and inertia assertions are stack-level' — yet the theorem_statement never introduces a stack base, never says which moduli problem the objects belong to, and therefore never defines Aut(x). (ii) The proof step 'An ordered automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation fixing the three images' is unavailable from the data defining x: I is built from Hilb⁶ and Pic⁶ only, and γ appears nowhere in its definition. The step is valid exactly when Aut(x) means automorphisms of the tetragonal cover, i.e. pairs (σ,τ) with γσ=τγ preserving Γ; it is not valid for Aut(C,Γ), the group that the downstream forgetful-map/stabilizer analysis in M_{6,6} needs (an automorphism of C preserving Γ need not preserve the pencil, and for genus 6 a nontrivial automorphism may fix up to 14 points, so the kernel statement is not formal). The remainder of the argument is correct under the cover reading: τ fixes three distinct images hence τ=id; σ is then a deck transformation fixing an étale marked point p; pr_1:C×_{P¹}C→C is étale at (p,p) because γ is étale at p; two sections of an étale morphism agreeing at a point agree on a neighbourhood; C integral and separated upgrades that to σ=id. The defect is one of statement/hypothesis, not of the computation: name the stack (e.g. the balanced tetragonal cover stack or an atlas thereof), say that Aut(x) is the automorphism group of the pair (C→P¹,Γ), and the clause becomes provable as written. See finding candidate FC-COMP-AUT-MODULI-UNDEFINED, and FC-COMP-PENCIL-RECOVERY-AUT for a repair that also reaches the M_{6,6}-relevant group on B_3.

Clause (1) component bijection and dimension formula check out over the declared reduced base. Input is ATT-0066 (H3)/CLM-0066-4, CLM-0066-5, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116 (both note that reducedness of B_k is load-bearing for Grauert and that P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) has the dual placed correctly). Verification: P(E_k^∨) is Zariski-locally U×P^{k-1} with U⊂Y open; P^{k-1} is geometrically irreducible over k, so each chart is irreducible, and any two nonempty opens of an irreducible Y meet, so P(E_k^∨|_Y) is irreducible; it is closed in I_k since Y is closed in B_k. Maximality: an irreducible closed T⊇P(E_k^∨|_Y) has irreducible image whose closure contains Y, hence equals Y, so T⊆P(E_k^∨|_Y). Conversely any component T of I_k has image contained in some component Y, so T⊆P(E_k^∨|_Y) and equality by maximality; the assignment is inverted by taking images, so the correspondence is bijective. dim P(E_k^∨|_Y)=dim Y+k−1 for a Zariski-locally trivial P^{k-1}-bundle. No normality is needed here (FND-0132 concerns étale covers and does not bite).

15+3−1=17 and 21−17=4 are correct arithmetic, dim M_{6,6}=3·6−3+6=21. The clause is properly conditionalized ('a 15-dimensional component'), applies the per-stratum formula rather than a uniform dim=15 (so it avoids the FND-0121 trap), and explicitly refuses to promote 4 to a codimension, closed-image, purity, or Gysin statement. No cohomological, weight, or Tate content is attached, so the target dictionary is untouched.

Faithful, in-scope restatement of ATT-0066 (H4)/CLM-0066-6 plus ATT-0065 CLM-0065-4 and CLM-0065-9, all four dual-confirmed. Conf_6(C/B)→Hilb⁶ factors through the distinct-support open and is a free finite S_6-quotient, so it is finite étale of degree |S_6|=720; base change along I^{dist}→Hilb^{6,dist} preserves this without any reducedness hypothesis, so 'without reducing either side' is both correct and the FND-0087-compliant formulation, and 'at stack level' is the FND-0075-compliant qualifier. The ambient clause correctly carries ATT-0065's extra hypotheses (q_*𝒲 finite locally free and compatible with arbitrary base change) rather than absorbing them; the degree conditions of ATT-0065 hold at (6,6) since 20−6=14>2g−2=10 and 16−6=10=2g−2.

Standard and correct Galois-category bookkeeping. The fibre of a principal S_6-torsor over a geometric point of a connected X is the regular right S_6-set; π_1^ét(X,x̄) acts by S_6-equivariant automorphisms, i.e. by left multiplication through ρ with image H_X (well defined up to conjugacy, so |H_X| and the condition H_X=S_6 are unambiguous). Orbits are the right cosets H_X g, all of cardinality |H_X| since the action is free, giving exactly [S_6:H_X]=720/|H_X| connected components each finite étale of degree |H_X|, and connectedness iff H_X=S_6. The claim is stated for CONNECTED components only and does not upgrade to irreducible components, so it correctly stays clear of the normality requirement of FND-0132. Vacuous if I^{dist}=∅, which the artifact lists as an open gap rather than assuming away.

finding_candidates.statement: In C66-GEO-COMP, any inertia/stabilizer clause of the form 1→Aut(x_tilde)→Aut(x)→S_6 for a geometric point x of the Abel–Jacobi incidence I=Hilb⁶(C/B)×_{Pic⁶(C/B)}B must first name the stack and the moduli problem, because I is defined without any reference to γ. Over a scheme base every such Aut is trivial and the clause is vacuous; over a stack base the group depends on what the base classifies. Rigidity proofs that pass through 'the automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation of P¹ fixing the marked images' prove the statement only for Aut(C,γ,Γ), automorphisms of the tetragonal cover preserving the divisor. They do not by themselves prove it for Aut(C,Γ), the group relevant to the forgetful map to M_{6,6}: an automorphism of C preserving Γ need not preserve the pencil, and triviality of the kernel is not formal, since a nontrivial automorphism of a genus-6 curve can fix as many as 2g+2=14 points and so can fix six marked points. Downstream artifacts must state which group they mean before citing such a clause.

finding_candidates.statement: On the stratum B_3 the tetragonal pencil is canonically recovered from the marked curve, so the two candidate automorphism groups coincide and the C66-GEO-COMP rigidity statement can be made for the M_{6,6}-relevant group. Concretely, for Γ in the incidence one has O(Γ)≅L relatively, hence M:=ω_C(-Γ)≅ω_C⊗L^{-1}=ω_C²⊗W_5^∨; under the weak CE relative-canonical normalization (FND-0105, ATT-0066/CLM-0066-2) M≅γ*O_{P¹}(1), which is base-point-free of degree 4, and on B_3 one has h⁰(L)=3 hence h⁰(M)=2, so |M| is a base-point-free PENCIL and equals the pencil defining γ; therefore γ is determined by (C,Γ) up to PGL_2. Consequently any σ∈Aut(C) with σ(Γ)=Γ satisfies σ*M≅M, preserves |M|, and induces τ∈PGL_2 with γσ=τγ, i.e. Aut(C,Γ)=Aut(C,γ,Γ) on B_3, and the deck-transformation rigidity argument (three distinct marked images plus one γ-étale marked point) applies verbatim to Aut(C,Γ). The recovery fails on B_4, where h⁰(M)=3 and |M| is a net containing many pencils.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack, and the one that lands: clause (4) is the only novel non-formal content of the artifact, and it is not well-posed under the artifact's own hypotheses. B is declared a reduced locally Noetherian k-SCHEME, so I^{dist} is a scheme and Aut(x)=1 for every geometric point x; read literally, the inertia sequence and the rigidity statement are vacuously true and carry no information. Read as intended (theorem_scope: 'the finite étale torsor and inertia assertions are stack-level') the objects are never named, and the proof's load-bearing step — that an ordered automorphism induces τ∈PGL_2 fixing the three marked images — is not available from the data defining I, which is built from Hilb⁶ and Pic⁶ alone and never mentions γ. The step holds only if Aut(x) is the automorphism group of the tetragonal cover (σ,τ) preserving Γ; it fails for Aut(C,Γ), which is the group the downstream M_{6,6} stabilizer analysis needs (FND-0098's 'stack-level full-faithfulness argument covering automorphism groups'). Either way, one clause of the theorem_statement is asserted without hypotheses that make it meaningful — the FND-0101 discipline applied to base scope rather than to a gap marker. Second-strongest attack, which fails: that clause (1) illicitly upgrades a Zariski-local product description to a global component bijection. It does not — maximality of P(E_k^∨|_Y) among irreducible closed subsets, and the fact that every component of I_k has image in some component of B_k, give the bijection cleanly, and P^{k-1} is geometrically irreducible so no field-extension irreducibility trap arises. Also pressed and failed: (a) Grauert over a non-reduced base (blocked by the declared reducedness and by the reduced structure on B_k); (b) one-sided reduction of the ordered/unordered pair (FND-0087; explicitly avoided by 'without reducing either side'); (c) connected versus irreducible components in the monodromy count (FND-0132; the artifact states only connected components, and the orbit count 720/|H_X| with degree |H_X| is exactly right for the regular S_6-set); (d) the FND-0121 trap of using dim=15 uniformly (avoided: the formula is dim(Y)+k−1 and 15 appears only inside an explicit hypothesis); (e) whether the ambient CE identification is imported unconditionally (it is not — ATT-0065's freeness and arbitrary-base-change hypotheses are carried in the statement). The entire cohomological attack list of the adversary prompt is inert against this artifact: it makes no Borel–Moore versus ordinary degree identification, no Poincaré duality or Tate twist, no Gysin or Künneth shift, no spectral-sequence or degeneration claim, no invariants-versus-coinvariants passage, no semisimplification-versus-isomorphism step, no predicted motive, and no pure-Tate-to-algebraic upgrade; it uses no coefficient ring, and it excludes all Hodge/weight/Tate conclusions and all forgetful/lci/Gysin properties. theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero and B a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let π:C→B be smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, and let γ:C→P¹_B be a finite flat degree-four cover with fibrewise balanced Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle O(4)⊕O(5), the canonical filtration with degree-16 quotient W_5, and the weak relative-canonical normalization assumed in ATT-0066. Put L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}, let B_k={b∈B:h⁰(L_b)=k} for k∈{3,4}, equipped with their reduced locally closed structures, and let I=Hilb⁶(C/B)×_{Pic⁶(C/B)}B be the Abel–Jacobi incidence of L. Then: (1) I_k:=I×_B B_k is a P^{k-1}-bundle over B_k. Its irreducible components correspond bijectively to those of B_k; the component over an irreducible component Y⊂B_k has dimension dim(Y)+k-1. In particular, a 15-dimensional component of B_3 gives a 17-dimensional incidence component, and 21−17=4 is only the numerical ambient dimension difference, not a closed-image or Gysin assertion. (2) Let I^{dist} be the open locus of divisors with six distinct support points and let I_tilde=Conf_6(C/B)×_{Hilb⁶(C/B)}I. Without reducing either side, I_tilde→I^{dist} is a finite étale S_6-torsor of degree 720 at stack level. On Conf_6 it is scheme-theoretically the intrinsic evaluation-failure locus; it is also the ambient balanced CE evaluation-failure locus when the additional ambient freeness and arbitrary-base-change hypotheses of ATT-0065 hold. (3) For every connected component X of I^{dist}, let H_X⊂S_6 be the image of the monodromy representation of this torsor. Then I_tilde×_{I^{dist}}X has exactly 720/|H_X| connected components, each finite étale of degree |H_X| over X. Thus it is connected exactly when H_X=S_6. (4) For a geometric point x of I^{dist} and a chosen ordering x_tilde above it, the action on the ordering fibre gives an exact sequence of geometric automorphism groups 1→Aut(x_tilde)→Aut(x)→S_6, where the last map records the induced permutation and need not be surjective. On the locus where the ordered marked points have at least three distinct images in P¹ and at least one marked point is étale for γ, Aut(x_tilde)=1; hence Aut(x) injects into S_6 there.
